problem: Constraints are the conditions that were true before this work and outlive it. Six are read straight from the manuals and the harness. Two are yours: what a live trial may cost, and what a live probe may never do.

questions.text: Is there a ceiling on what the run may spend on live trials, and if so in what unit?
questions.why: Statistical and judged checks run real sessions. The addendum says keep scenario sets small; a number turns that into a check the run can be held to.

options.value: No number in the spec; the test-builder keeps scenario sets small and the run log records what was spent.
A ceiling in scenarios: at most N scenarios in the whole suite, each run at most k times (give N and k in the comment).
A ceiling in tokens or dollars for the whole run (give it in the comment).

questions.text: A live probe exercises the real system: it can open worktrees, cut branches, run hooks and commands. What must it never do?
questions.why: C8 as drafted forbids reaching a remote. Anything else forbidden has to be written, because a probe that can do a thing will eventually do it.

options.value: Never reach a remote (push, pull request, fetch) and never write outside a temporary repository; that is the whole list.
Also never start a live session at all; probes drive scripts with synthetic envelopes only.
Something else: name it in the comment.
